beats.label: setup
beats.text: I went to the Galactic Bureaucracy to file a complaint. The clerk — a gray, four feet tall, big eyes — he says, 'What seems to be the problem?'

beats.label: escalation
beats.text: And I say, 'Doc, I don't even know what I'm doing anymore. I work in HR on Zeta Reticuli, and all day long, I process forms. Honestly, I don't even know what I'm processing anymore. I don't even know if the Supervisor knows. He only knows he has power over me, and that seems to bring him happiness.'

beats.label: deadpan
beats.text: And the gray says, 'You should see a psychiatrist.' And I say, 'But Doc — the light was on.'

beats.label: closer
beats.text: And the gray just stares at me. Because on Zeta Reticuli, the light is ALWAYS on.
